svg.title: Following turtles across the Indian Ocean
svg.desc: Real GPS observations of hawksbill and green turtles. Two selected tracks, animals 52231 and 64792, are shown over Natural Earth coastlines, with an inset of recorded movements around Diego Garcia. The full visible dataset contains 88,727 valid observations from 23 turtles. Static geographic visualization, not simulated movement.
svg.text: Real GPS tracks · Chagos Archipelago & the western Indian Ocean
Two selected tracks from the full dataset
GPS: Marine Migration Visualizer source dataset · Coastlines: Natural Earth · Lines break at gaps >48 h or steps >200 km
